title: The guard refuses Edit and Write in the pointer checkout
why: A lane edited the shared pointer checkout that other sessions read; guard pointer-head stopped only its branch switch, not the edits.
note: Coordinator, 04:28 CST Nov 9. Incident: lane fresh-round3-route (#2411) edited the pointer checkout first; guard pointer-head refused only the branch switch. Harm: edits land in a shared checkout that other sessions read. Unassigned; the coordinator routes it after batch 68.
